user.title: Lockin V5 Max INT
user.description: Independent, read-only cloud connection for loock.lock.v2203 only. Does not require the Xiaomi Home integration. Use Singapore for the existing Australia account. No lock controls or physical door-position inference.

login.title: Authorize your account
login.description: [Open account login]({login_url}). Complete authorization in a browser on your home network. The registered callback is http://homeassistant.local:8123; it must resolve to this Home Assistant. When the browser says authorization received, return here and press Submit. This link expires after 10 minutes. Never paste codes or tokens into chat.

device.title: Select your Lockin
device.description: Only Lockin V5 Max INT (loock.lock.v2203) devices are listed.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew account authorization
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to the same account to restore the lock's reporting connection. This does not operate the lock.

error.login_pending: Complete the account login first, then press Submit.

abort.login_failed: Authorization or device discovery failed. Start setup again; check the selected server and network.
abort.no_supported_device: No accessible loock.lock.v2203 was found on this account/server. Other models are not supported.
abort.reauth_wrong_account: The original lock was not found. Sign in with its original account.
